pages.text: Nutrition is handled by $(l)RP Culinary$(): satiety in calories, water, protein, fat, carbs and vitamins, body weight. Press $(l)K$() to see how you feel.

How nutrition affects the body:$(br)- Low protein — wounds heal slower, weaker punches.$(br)- Low fat — you feel cold.$(br)- Low carbs — no energy, you tire fast.$(br)- Low vitamins — you get sick more often.$(br)- Balanced — better healing and immunity.$(br2)Exact values — only by a blood test.
$(l)Hunger$() does not kill: first weakness, then hunger faints. The hungry heal worse. $(l)Dehydration$() lowers blood volume and pressure.
